requests: A little thirsty today… could you give me some water?
My leaves are feeling a bit droopy. I think I need a drink.
Could I have some water, please? 💧
I think I’ve been waiting for my little drink…
Water, please? I’m feeling a little parched.
My soil feels a little dry today.
Could you give me a sip? I’ll feel much happier.
replies: Ahh, that feels better. Now go have some water too, okay?
Thank you. 💧 Your turn now — take a little sip for yourself.
All refreshed! And hey… when was the last time *you* had some water?
That was lovely. Please remember to keep yourself hydrated too.
Much better. Now let me remind you: plants aren’t the only ones who need water. 🤍
Thank you for taking care of me. Now take care of you, too — drink some water.
Happy and hydrated again. You should be, too. 🌱

requests: I think I could use a little nourishment today.
Could you give me something good to grow with?
I’m feeling a little hungry…
A little nourishment would make me very happy.
I think it’s time for something nourishing.
Could I have a little food, please?
I need some good things to help me grow.
replies: Mmm, thank you. Now please remember to feed yourself something good too.
That helped me grow. I hope you give yourself something nourishing today, too.
All fed! Now… have you eaten something today?
Thank you for taking care of me. Please don’t forget to take care of your tummy, too. 🤍
Feeling nourished again. Your turn — go find yourself something good to eat.
That was just what I needed. I hope you’re giving yourself what you need, too.
I’m growing because you feed me. Make sure you’re giving yourself enough fuel, too. 🌱

requests: Could you give me a little sunshine today?
I’d love to feel some warm light on my leaves.
It feels a little dim here… can I have some sunshine?
A little light would make me very happy.
Could we find me a sunny little spot?
I think I’m ready for some sunshine.
My leaves are asking for a little light today. ☀️
replies: Mmm, that feels lovely. You should get a little sunshine too.
Thank you. Now maybe step outside and let the sun find you, too?
All warmed up! A little daylight might do you some good, too. 🤍
That was nice. Remember, you need a little light sometimes, too.
Feeling brighter already. I hope you find a little brightness for yourself today.
Thank you for finding me some sunshine. Now go borrow a little for yourself.
Look at me soaking it all in. You should go get some sunshine too. 🌱

requests: Could I have a little love today?
I think I need some extra love from you.
Can you give me a little attention? I missed you.
I could really use a gentle little moment with you.
Will you spend a little time with me?
I’m feeling a little lonely today… stay with me for a moment?
Could you give me some love? I promise I’ll keep growing.
replies: Thank you for loving me. Now be a little gentle with yourself, too.
That made me so happy. I hope you’re giving yourself that same kindness.
I feel very loved. I hope you remember that you deserve love too. 🤍
Thank you for staying with me. Don’t forget to stay with yourself, too.
That was lovely. Now take a little moment to be kind to yourself.
I’m feeling better already. I hope you are, too.
You take such good care of me. Please remember that you deserve the same care. 🌱
